question: Δ ABC ~ Δ QPR and (area of Δ ABC) : (area of Δ PQR)= 3 : 2 . If AB = 12 cm, BC = 10 cm, and AC = 9 cm, then the length of QR (in cm) is:
solution:
Given:

ΔABC ~ ΔQPR

area of ΔABC : area of ΔPQR = 3 : 2

AB = 12 cm, BC = 10 cm and AC = 9 cm

Concept used:

If a ΔABC ∼ ΔQPR, arABC/arQPR = (AC/QR)2

Calculation:

⇒ arABC/arQPR = (AC/QR)2

⇒ (9/QR)2 = 3/2

⇒ QR² = (81× 2)/3

⇒ QR2 = (27× 2)

⇒ QR = 3√ 6 cm

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
